study: controlled one-step quadratic mechanism attacks, no model training
primary_outcome: independent evaluation loss decrease, common random numbers
primary_interval: paired Student-t, 98.333333% each; Bonferroni familywise 95% for three contrasts
secondary_intervals: paired Student-t 95%; descriptive without familywise claims
stopping: fixed n; no optional stopping, exclusions or replacements; runtime/certificate errors invalidate the run
selection: For each map/regime choose the best of 24 parameter/stepsize trials on development true quadratic progress; primary uses chosen RASP gamma but fixed stepsize and equal update norms. No final draws select parameters.
peer_scope: phase02 one-step mathematical maps; not full training parity, all-peer superiority, or replication of source implementations

coverage.known_statistic: (a-b)^2/4 for independent N(0,3^2) half errors; expectation 4.5

negative_control: gamma0, E=0 and deterministic exact case are numerically identical; corrupted replicas are retained even when they fail calibration or reverse progress
cost_gate: Count all SVDs, Gram work and exact ring communication. Dense active SVD+bisection is a reference only; no TPU competitiveness claim without later certified kernel. Do not conceal repeated projections.
approval_boundary: Only phases 01 and 02 authorized; phase03 implementations and all training remain not_started
